content: Furthermore, the Construction Industry Development Board (CIDB) provides data on public sector infrastructure projects. The CIDB's mandate includes managing a register of contractors and monitoring public sector construction projects. While its project tracking systems can vary in completeness, they offer a valuable glimpse into government infrastructure spending, from the construction of new roads, dams, and power stations to the development of public buildings like hospitals and schools. Analyzing the funding structure of a project can reveal dependencies on volatile commodity prices or risky financial instruments. This committee would assess not only the financial viability of the project but also associated risks such as construction cost overruns, planning permission delays, and market demand uncertainty.
